    b2=sum(1 for r in range(H-1) for c in range(W-1) if s[r][c] and s[r+1][c] and s[r][c+1] and s[r+1][c+1])
    # diagonal adjacencies
    dg=sum(1 for r in range(H-1) for c in range(W-1) if s[r][c] and s[r+1][c+1])
    dg2=sum(1 for r in range(H-1) for c in range(W-1) if s[r][c+1] and s[r+1][c])
    # perimeter (edge-exposed)
    per=sum(1 for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if s[r][c] for x,y in((r+1,c),(r-1,c),(r,c+1),(r,c-1)) if not(0<=x<H and 0<=y<W and s[x][y]))
    return dict(cells=n,b2=b2,dg=dg,dg2=dg2,per=per,rh=None)

    for i,s in enumerate(shapes):
        f=shape_feats(s); f.update(feats2(s))
        print(i,{k:v for k,v in f.items() if k not in('H','W')})
